title: When Jennifer Lopez helped launch a telemedicine network for children in Panama
summary_full: In 2012, Jennifer Lopez and her sister Lynda Lopez donated telemedicine equipment through their family foundation to improve healthcare access for children in Panama. The initiative connected hospitals and health centres across the country with specialists at Children's Hospital Los Angeles, allowing doctors to seek medical advice remotely. The programme also supported medical training, specialist consultations and knowledge-sharing among healthcare professionals.
